text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Duramente didn't show up for 
training, I searched around and found her 
in the library.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
!? I'm sorry...! I was so absorbed in my 
book, I didn't notice!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I was reading an astronomy magazine and 
inadvertently... started pondering... the 
vastness of the universe. Letting my 
consciousness drift far, far beyond the 
infinite reaches...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Duramente seemed genuinely remorseful. I 
cautioned her to be more careful from now 
on.
